newsitem.title: UK: Buyers disappear on UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Buyers disappear on UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: Buyers disappeared on the UK meals and feeds market despite sharply lower high protein soymeal prices on Thursday following the limit down close in Chicago.
"Buyers ran for the hills after they saw the prices, I think in the hope that the market will be even lower on Friday," said one Broker.
Other brokers reported a lot of interest during the morning but none of it was turned into business.
"Things looked quite hopeful at first but we have not seen any business," said another broker.
High protein soymeal ex-mill was five to two stg down, while the remainder of the market was unchanged.
